chunks: Whatever is in Hāʾ from Jābir ibn Ismāʿīl, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah have mercy on him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdillāh, from Salamah ibn al-Khaṭṭāb, from Muḥammad ibn al-Layth, from Jābir ibn Ismāʿīl.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father, from whom the author narrates
key_terms.جَابِرِ بْنِ إِسْمَاعِيلَ: the transmitter to whom this sanad/isnad leads

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Jābir ibn Ismāʿīl in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Jābir ibn Ismāʿīl in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the precise chain of transmission, which is central to hadith preservation and evaluation in Shia scholarship.
